parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main body of the globe, made of plastic and printed with a world map. It is approximately 25 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It represents the Earth and rotates around its axis to show different regions and countries for educational purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, made of durable plastic, consisting of a stand and an arm that holds the sphere.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and allows the sphere to rotate smoothly while keeping it elevated and balanced.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while supporting the rotating sphere.
